sharing_rule: Exact original reference and rendered presentation. Existing external portrait family aliases omit only unused fallback ornaments; project atlases remain strict.
authoring_instructions:
MAIN EXACT PROMPT:
Create a new fully transparent RGBA 2D sprite atlas based on the attached ORIGINAL image. The original is the authoritative character design, color, equipment and proportion reference. A LARGE SQUARE CANVAS with EXACTLY8 equal columns and8 equal rows,64 SMALL complete and genuinely articulated poses. Each full body/held object/flame must occupy LESS THAN HALF its cell width and height. Huge empty transparent horizontal and vertical gutters and safe outer borders: no body, tip, leaf or flame can touch or enter the rectangle of any adjacent pose. Direction columns exactly E true right-side view, SE front-right, S front toward viewer/screen down, SW front-left, W true left-side view, NW back-left, N full rear away/screen up, NE back-right. Clearly distinct front, side, diagonal, and rear orientation, never mirror/flip pixels. Rows1 relaxed idle,2 distinct breathing/flickering idle,3 walking/travel phaseA,4 distinct phaseB,5 distinct phaseC,6 attack windup,7 attack contact toward its column direction,8 attack recovery. No extra rows. Every pose is independently articulated, never translated/scaled duplicate stills. Entire silhouette is connected. No floor, cast shadow, black background, labels, grid, card border or detached particles. Preserve the source portrait unchanged and create a separate new atlas. Preserve the ACTUAL character in the attached original, regardless of its database name: a tiny round green frog-like face with large eyes, dark red/brown small body/clothing, short limbs, and the prominent broad green leaf overhead on its held stem plus the small brown held instrument/stick visible in the portrait. Keep the leaf, original costume details, exact held-object anatomy and original green/red/dark-brown palette. Never replace it with an ordinary naked white frog or invent a large horned beast. Preserve the source's charming compact proportions and softly shaded 2D game sprite treatment. Omit only the detached musical-note icons and black portrait background. Walking uses the actual two supporting feet with coherent leaf grip; the melee attack draws the original held forelimb/object back, leans forward toward the exact compass direction on contact, then returns to guard.
HIT/DEATH EXACT PROMPT:
Create a separate HIT/DEATH atlas for the character in the FIRST attached original portrait, using the SECOND attached main atlas only as a pose style and scale guide. Preserve the original identity, exact equipment, color and proportions. Fully transparent RGBA; clean clear gutters, no ambient glow, fog, detached sparks, text, musical notes, shadow or card background. Exactly8 direction columns and5 phase rows=40 full independently articulated poses, no added rows. Each whole body including leaf/held object/flame occupies LESS THAN HALF of its cell width and height, with huge empty transparent gutters in both axes and clear outer borders. Direction columns E right true side, SE front-right, S front facing down/viewer, SW front-left, W left true side, NW rear-left, N full rear away/up, NE rear-right. Rows1 HIT recoil,2 HIT recovery,3 death buckling,4 death collapse,5 terminal entirely FLAT collapsed corpse/ember. Never leave the last row upright. Preserve all eight views while collapsing. Keep all complete silhouettes and any held objects connected; no touching or overlapping adjacent poses. All forty poses differ through actual articulated anatomy or organic flame shape, not repeated/scaled stills. Preserve the ACTUAL character in the attached original, regardless of its database name: a tiny round green frog-like face with large eyes, dark red/brown small body/clothing, short limbs, and the prominent broad green leaf overhead on its held stem plus the small brown held instrument/stick visible in the portrait. Keep the leaf, original costume details, exact held-object anatomy and original green/red/dark-brown palette. Never replace it with an ordinary naked white frog or invent a large horned beast. Preserve the source's charming compact proportions and softly shaded 2D game sprite treatment. Omit only the detached musical-note icons and black portrait background. Walking uses the actual two supporting feet with coherent leaf grip; the melee attack draws the original held forelimb/object back, leans forward toward the exact compass direction on contact, then returns to guard. During hit the frog recoils while keeping the leaf and held original stick/instrument. Death bends knees, slumps forward, and ends entirely flat with the leaf and instrument still physically connected to its hands/body. Retain full original face and green leaf in all phases.
